'''House Malvern''' was one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Counts]] of this house took to wearing black clothing and black capes with white fur trim on the shoulders.
